$comment: Semantic colour tokens. Re-derived by feature 005 T521 as one lightness ramp per theme — surfaces, inks, and a single chromatic band whose members differ only in hue. The full derivation, the per-token record, and each role's declared surfaces are in packages/design-system/specs/color-tokens.md; $rationale below carries the one-line form. Same names in both themes — a component never knows which is active (design-system skill, 'Tokens'). Warm parchment/bronze palette evoking the era without reusing any Microsoft asset (constitution X); the eight player-* fills and their -contrast inks are canonical game colours, theme-invariant, and are retained unchanged (packages/design-system/specs/game-asset-tokens.md). Edit here, then run `pnpm --filter design-system tokens:build`.

$rationale.$comment: One line per token, FR-001a/SC-001a: derived (with its ramp step) or retained (with the reason). The full derivation, the measured ratios and each role's declared surfaces are in packages/design-system/specs/color-tokens.md. Stripped by build-tokens.mjs's top-level $-filter; never emitted as a variable.

light.background: derived: surface ramp L* 91.5, the page tone; warm parchment at hue 42.
light.surface: derived: surface ramp L* 96.0, one lift step above the page.
light.surface-raised: derived: surface ramp L* 98.7, the lightest surface. Reordered above `surface` — this is the single move that returns margin to every ink painted on a raised surface.
light.surface-sunken: derived: surface ramp L* 85.3, one step below the page; well, track, disabled fill, row hover.
light.border: derived: ink band, L* 61.6. Set against `background` at 2.4:1 because a MatchRow table separator is load-bearing in a data tool; yields 2.7:1 on `surface`, up from 1.6:1.
light.border-strong: derived: ink band, L* 45.2. Set against `surface-sunken`, its tightest adjacency, so it clears the 3:1 non-text floor on all four surfaces (3.6-5.2:1).
light.text-primary: derived: ink ramp L* 10.2; >=11.6:1 on every declared surface.
light.text-secondary: derived: ink ramp L* 32.7, 22.5 below primary; 5.8:1 on surface-sunken, up from 4.7:1.
light.text-disabled: derived: ink ramp L* 49.6. Exempt from AA (WCAG 1.4.3, inactive) but held to 3:1 on its real fill, because a disabled control here often carries the explanation.
light.text-inverse: derived: the page tone, reused as the ink for a `text-primary`-filled region. No call site today; see color-tokens.md section 6 for the standing obligation.
light.accent: derived: chromatic band L* 40.8, hue 38 — muted gold. Band top, so it is the member that fixes the band's ceiling.
light.accent-hover: derived: one interaction step (-6.2 L*) away from the page.
light.accent-active: derived: two interaction steps (-13.0 L*); a press reads as ink into the surface, in both themes.
light.accent-contrast: derived: the light theme's one light ink (= surface-raised); 6.1:1 on accent, 9.8:1 on accent-active.
light.success: derived: chromatic band L* 36.0, hue 118 — moss, desaturated; never a signal green.
light.success-contrast: derived: the light theme's one light ink; 7.3:1 on success.
light.warning: derived: chromatic band L* 36.7, hue 28 — burnt amber, redder than accent. 7.1:1 on surface-raised, against a 4.5 floor it previously cleared by two hundredths.
light.warning-contrast: derived: the light theme's one light ink; 7.1:1 on warning, replacing a 3.47:1 pair the register flagged as unbuildable.
light.danger: derived: chromatic band L* 36.2, hue 7 — iron oxide, never a pure red.
light.danger-contrast: derived: the light theme's one light ink; 7.2:1 on danger.
light.info: derived: chromatic band L* 35.8, hue 187 — slate teal. Separated from focus-ring, which it used to equal value-for-value.
light.info-contrast: derived: the light theme's one light ink; 7.3:1 on info.
light.focus-ring: derived: chromatic band L* 33.2, hue 214 — the system's most saturated value, because a ring must never read as decoration. Clears 3:1 on all four surfaces (5.7-8.2:1). Does NOT declare accent: see color-tokens.md section 5.
light.overlay: derived: text-primary at 55%. A scrim carries no foreground and owes no pair; what it owes is that the dialog above it reads (research D9).
light.player-1: retained: canonical game colour, color_id 1, theme-invariant (game-asset-tokens.md).
light.player-1-contrast: retained: measured 4.8:1 ink on Blue; the one fill needing the light ink.
light.player-2: retained: canonical game colour, color_id 2, theme-invariant.
light.player-3: retained: canonical game colour, color_id 3, theme-invariant.
light.player-4: retained: canonical game colour, color_id 4, theme-invariant.
light.player-5: retained: canonical game colour, color_id 5, theme-invariant.
light.player-6: retained: canonical game colour, color_id 6, theme-invariant.
light.player-7: retained: canonical game colour, color_id 7, theme-invariant.
light.player-7-contrast: retained: measured 4.8:1 ink on Grey, the tightest fill.
light.player-8: retained: canonical game colour, color_id 8, theme-invariant.

dark.background: derived: surface ramp L* 7.6, the page tone.
dark.surface: derived: surface ramp L* 11.8, one lift step above the page.
dark.surface-raised: derived: surface ramp L* 16.7, the lightest surface; the theme's tightest ink backdrop, so it sets the chromatic band's floor.
dark.surface-sunken: derived: surface ramp L* 4.2, one step below the page.
dark.border: derived: ink band L* 40.1, set to match the light theme's separator strength (2.6:1 on surface, against light's 2.7:1).
dark.border-strong: derived: ink band L* 57.4; 4.2-5.6:1 across the four surfaces, clearing the 3:1 non-text floor on all of them.
dark.text-primary: derived: ink ramp L* 91.9; >=11.8:1 on every declared surface.
dark.text-secondary: derived: ink ramp L* 74.3, 17.6 below primary; 8.9:1 on `background`, the pair ProfileSummary draws and the table never carried.
dark.text-disabled: derived: ink ramp L* 51.3; 3.4:1 on surface-raised, 4.5:1 on surface-sunken. Exempt from AA, held to 3:1 anyway.
dark.text-inverse: derived: the page tone, reused as the ink for a `text-primary`-filled region. No call site today.
dark.accent: derived: chromatic band L* 70.9, hue 39 — muted gold.
dark.accent-hover: derived: one interaction step (+7.4 L*) away from the page.
dark.accent-active: derived: darker than rest (-7.3 L*), the one place the two themes differ in direction; a press reads as pressed, not more lifted.
dark.accent-contrast: derived: the dark theme's one dark ink (= background); 8.1:1 on accent, 6.4:1 on accent-active.
dark.success: derived: chromatic band L* 69.2, hue 105 — moss.
dark.success-contrast: derived: the dark theme's one dark ink; 8.2:1 on success.
dark.warning: derived: chromatic band L* 69.0, hue 26 — burnt amber, moved off gold so it no longer reads as accent.
dark.warning-contrast: derived: the dark theme's one dark ink; 7.6:1 on warning.
dark.danger: derived: chromatic band L* 68.1, hue 11; 6.0:1 on surface-raised, up from the 4.6:1 the register flagged as the tightest dark pair.
dark.danger-contrast: derived: the dark theme's one dark ink; 7.4:1 on danger.
dark.info: derived: chromatic band L* 67.8, hue 191 — slate teal.
dark.info-contrast: derived: the dark theme's one dark ink; 7.3:1 on info.
dark.focus-ring: derived: chromatic band L* 64.9, hue 213; clears 3:1 on all four surfaces (5.4-7.1:1). Does NOT declare accent: see color-tokens.md section 5.
dark.overlay: retained: rgb(0 0 0 / 65%). The dark theme's own tones are too close to the page to darken it; a scrim must remove the page, so this is the one place the palette uses absolute black — the same reasoning game-asset-tokens.md used for the seven black player inks.

dark.player-1-contrast: retained: measured 4.8:1 ink on Blue; the one fill needing the light ink.
